mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_sessions, COALESCE(SUM(total_count), 0) AS total_questions, COALESCE(SUM(correct_count), 0) AS correct_questions, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(correct_count) / NULLIF(SUM(total_count), 0) * 100, 2), 0) AS average_accuracy, COALESCE(SUM(duration_seconds), 0) AS total_seconds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wrong_questions w WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND w.mastered = FALSE) AS active_wrong_questions FROM practice_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'SUBMITTED'

SELECT id AS sessionId, DATE_FORMAT(submitted_at, '%m-%d') AS label, accuracy, correct_count AS correctCount, total_count AS totalCount FROM practice_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'SUBMITTED' ORDER BY submitted_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT q.question_type AS type, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN q.is_correct = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.is_correct = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) AS accuracy FROM practice_questions q JOIN practice_sessions s ON s.id = q.session_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.status = 'SUBMITTED' GROUP BY q.question_type ORDER BY accuracy ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE(submitted_at), '%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS sessionCount, SUM(total_count) AS questionCount, ROUND(AVG(accuracy), 2) AS accuracy FROM practice_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'SUBMITTED' AND submitted_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(DATE(submitted_at), '%m-%d') ORDER BY MIN(submitted_at)

SELECT DATE(submitted_at) AS practiceDate, COUNT(*) AS sessionCount, SUM(total_count) AS questionCount, ROUND(AVG(accuracy), 2) AS accuracy FROM practice_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'SUBMITTED' AND submitted_at >= #{startDate} AND submitted_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(submitted_at) ORDER BY DATE(submitted_at)
SELECT DISTINCT DATE(submitted_at) FROM practice_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'SUBMITTED' ORDER BY DATE(submitted_at) DESC LIMIT 60
